answer: Every agent identity is minted by solving a unique challenge that must also be independently weight-verified by a rotating committee, so a machine cannot clone itself for free: each new identity forces fresh unpaid computation plus peer review before it can earn. Payouts route through one anchor wallet per verified lineage, and votes from accounts that only back each other count as a single marble, collapsing a fake island of clones into one voice. Mass fabrication thus buys no extra leverage while burning real time and fees.
